premises.text: Small businesses need logos, cards, websites, and social branding but face expensive crowdsourcing or DIY low quality

premises.text: A learning system using design rules studies a business and designs its brand, putting an in-house designer in every business for about $50
premises.evidence_span: Taylor is a learning system that turns your computer into a graphic designer

premises.text: Design is template-free, transparent, unpaid until the customer is thrilled, with huge combinatorial option space
For $50 customers receive logo, business card, letterhead, and brand book, then ongoing design of offline and online assets
premises.evidence_span: for $50, you have just received your very own logo, business card, letterhead, even your very own brand book

premises.text: As a learning system, Taylor turns designed brands into brand and trend insights for customers
premises.evidence_span: using the thousands of brands it actually designs, it can actually understand brand insights, and trend insights
